name: Click Between Frames
description: Allows inputs to register between frames.

soft-toggle.name: Disable CBF
soft-toggle.description: Disable CBF/CoS without needing to restart GD. This option does not disable physics bypass if you have it enabled!

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: Disable progress & stats on rated levels.

click-on-steps.name: Click on Steps
click-on-steps.description: Only register inputs with 240TPS precision. Should have identical physics to vanilla.

mouse-fix.name: Reduce Mouse Lag
mouse-fix.description:
Reduce lag when using high polling rate mice.
Experimental, may break things.

precision-fix.name: Precision Fix
precision-fix.description:
Improve input precision by preventing framerate desync.
Experimental, may break things.

physics-bypass.name: Enable Physics Bypass
physics-bypass.description:
Reduces stuttering on some FPS values. Active even if "Disable CBF" is checked.

The physics mode is picked automatically per level: 2.2 levels use as few collision checks per frame as possible (with a minimum of 240 checks per second), while levels made before 2.2 use 2.1 physics (4 collision checks per frame at 60fps or above).

THIS WILL ALTER PHYSICS AND MAY BREAK SOME LEVELS! DON'T USE THIS IF YOUR LIST/LEADERBOARD BANS PHYSICS BYPASS!
